notes: How this part was researched: the session's shared web-search allowance ran out after 21 searches (the first 21 candidates of the slice, through Brian Vroman). Everything after that was read by opening pages directly with the kit's honest User-Agent (robots.txt obeyed) or with the page-reading tool: the candidates' own sites, each county's, city's and school district's own site, the Minnesota DFL's list of endorsed candidates, the Olmsted County Republicans' newsletter, the University of Minnesota's election archive and two named news organizations.

Campaign websites as filed were learned from a scratch copy of the database on which the kit's own step (python -m ballot.local_sites files) had been run; each was then opened. Rick Storlie's filed site (https://storlie4plsas.com) could not be read: the kit's script got a script-only page and the page-reading tool an empty one, so it is not recorded here.

Left blank on purpose: the two judges (Dean Eyler, Thomas Robert Lehmann), because mncourts.gov refuses scripts and answered the page-reading tool 403, and it was not pressed; Tim Luoma (the Lake County Sheriff's pages read do not name him); Kenneth Warning, Marisa Allen, Evett Ellis, Jonathan Melgaard, Lerew Kaas, Brian Vroman, Zachary Simon Blumberg and Rick Storlie (their city's or district's board pages do not list them as members, and nothing else was tied to them by two anchors). KAXE's guides give an age on Election Day for Craig Gaasvig (58) and Marisa Allen (44), which fits two birth years each, so no birth year is recorded. Steven E Jacob and Matt Norris are sitting legislators with record pages, so only a website and an endorsement were sought; no campaign site was found for Jacob.

Not recorded: news reports say the DFL endorsed the incumbent in Sharon El-Amin's race, which is no finding about her. Nicole Farrelly's site says she serves as Vice Chair of SD56, District Five, a party post and not a public office. KNSI (May 20, 2026) reports Mike Conway filed for the Republican primary without the party's endorsement.
